title: Troubleshooting Failed Payments with Pending Charges
body: If a payment fails but the card shows a pending charge, explain that the authorization hold will drop within 3-5 business days. Confirm with the payment provider if necessary, and offer a manual retry or alternative payment method.

title: API Outage Runbook for us-west-2
body: When error rates spike in us-west-2, first check service health dashboards, then roll traffic to a healthy region if possible. Notify the on-call SRE and update the status page if customer-facing impact is confirmed.

title: Inspection Tool Camera Error 0x54
body: Error 0x54 usually indicates intermittent connectivity issues with the camera module. Instruct the engineer to reseat connectors, capture logs, and run the built-in hardware diagnostics. Escalate to hardware if error persists.

title: General Support Response Guidelines
body: Always acknowledge the customer's issue, restate the problem in your own words, and provide a clear next step. Avoid jargon and set expectations for follow-up time.
